newsitem.title: UK: Greenalls to merge pub units, take charge.
newsitem.headline: Greenalls to merge pub units, take charge.

text.p: Britain's Greenalls Group Plc said on Tuesday it would merge two public house and restaurant divisions and take a reorganisation charge of 7.3 million pounds ($11.8 million) in the current year.
The company predicted annualised cost savings of about 3.5 million pounds from the merger of the two divisions and a plan to transfer managed houses to a franchise division.
Greenalls also said it expected to cut about 100 jobs at its divisional head offices.
"The formation of one new Pubs & Restaurants division enables us to take full advantage of emerging trends," the company said in a statement, adding that the action would eliminate duplicated costs.
Greenalls projected the new unit's capital spending at 85 million pounds this year.
The company also said it would speed up its programme of tenanted pub disposals.
The firm planned to merge its Premier House group of about 175 branded pub restaurants, including 46 lodges, with Greenalls Inn Retail, its chain of 920 managed pubs.
In addition, 245 managed houses would be transferred from Greenalls Inn Retail to Inn Partnership, the group's franchised and tenanted pub operation.
